QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_70

question.text: Under SAS-1300 the 'women-owned-account' indicator should be disaggregated by:

answer.text: Age, rural/urban, SC/ST/OBC/General, income quintile, and first-time-or-not — to reveal inclusion patterns

explanation.text: The Logic: SAS-1300's substantive financial-inclusion lens requires disaggregation by age, geography, caste/community, income, and first-time status. Aggregate numbers mask whether the programme reached the intended marginalised sub-segments. The Trap: Options B, C, D are inadequate or irrelevant. Cross-Exam Context: Disaggregation logic also in SEBI BRSR (III-A / III-C Compliance) and SDG monitoring frameworks. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Publish a '5-dimension disaggregation matrix' as a standard annexure. Reviewers penalise aggregate-only inclusion claims severely.
